title: Command Remover
description: Removes/ Rewrites commands registered by client side mods or the server.
body:
Client Side mod that lets you remove Client Side (by other mods registered) and Server Side commands.


Add command names to config/commandremover.txt, one per line, to remove them.

Prefix with @ to hide them but still be able to run it via /rc <command>.

/rc will only be added if there is at least one command rewritten to /rc.

If youd like to contact me, my Discord Username is **jo29_29**.
